title: BlitzReels Video Editor
description: Create, edit, reframe, caption, organize, generate, and export short-form videos with BlitzReels.
summary: Create, edit, reframe, caption, organize, generate, and export short-form videos with BlitzReels.
offersHint: Create, edit, reframe, caption, organize, generate, and export short-form videos with BlitzReels. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://www.blitzreels.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: projects_list
toolsPreview.description: List the user's BlitzReels projects with status, duration, and basic metadata.

toolsPreview.name: projects_get
toolsPreview.description: Get details for one BlitzReels project, including timeline summary, clips, and captions.

toolsPreview.name: projects_inspect
toolsPreview.description: Read bounded project context for editing, including timeline items, media assets, transcripts, captions, and stable IDs.

toolsPreview.name: exports_list
toolsPreview.description: List exports with render status and progress. Completed exports include a signed download URL. Pass exportId to return one export.

toolsPreview.name: media_list
toolsPreview.description: List media files in user's library (videos, audio, images)

toolsPreview.name: media_transcript_get
toolsPreview.description: Get transcript summary metadata or a bounded window of transcription segments for a video asset.

toolsPreview.name: projects_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a new private BlitzReels video project.

toolsPreview.name: media_upload_file
toolsPreview.description: Import a video, audio, or image file from ChatGPT into the BlitzReels media library. Use this for a file the user attached or picked, and for an image ChatGPT generated in this conversation that the user wants to keep, animate, or edit in BlitzReels.

toolsPreview.name: media_import_url
toolsPreview.description: Import a video, audio, or image from a direct URL into the BlitzReels media library.

toolsPreview.name: media_upload_start
toolsPreview.description: Get a presigned URL for direct file upload (for large files)

toolsPreview.name: media_upload_finish
toolsPreview.description: Complete the upload process after uploading to a presigned URL

toolsPreview.name: media_import_inspect
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a video URL can be imported and return its title, duration, qualities, and audio tracks. Use for a social video link, a Google Drive file link, or a direct video file URL. Use media_import_scan_page instead when the URL is a web page that only embeds a video.

toolsPreview.name: media_import_scan_page
toolsPreview.description: Scan a web page and return the importable video URL found inside it. Use only when the URL is a page rather than a video; media_import_inspect already handles social, Google Drive, and direct video URLs.

toolsPreview.name: clips_presets_list
toolsPreview.description: List available clip batch presets and their clipping/caption defaults.

toolsPreview.name: captions_themes_list
toolsPreview.description: List built-in caption looks and saved caption themes available to a workspace.

toolsPreview.name: media_assets_get
toolsPreview.description: Get metadata and processing state for one media-library asset without returning transcript segments.

toolsPreview.name: media_assets_preview
toolsPreview.description: Return one bounded JPEG as MCP image content for visual inspection. Images use the stored visual; videos use the existing thumbnail.

toolsPreview.name: media_folders_list
toolsPreview.description: List one bounded level of media-library folders and direct asset counts.

toolsPreview.name: media_folders_create
toolsPreview.description: Create one media-library folder in a workspace and return a retry-safe mutation receipt.

toolsPreview.name: media_assets_update
toolsPreview.description: Rename one media asset, edit its description, move it to a folder, or change B-roll eligibility. Provide at least one of name, description, folderId, or allowUsingAsBroll.

toolsPreview.name: clips_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a BlitzReels clip batch from an existing video asset or an import URL. Supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Google Drive, and direct video URLs.

toolsPreview.name: clips_get
toolsPreview.description: Get status, generated clips, render counts, and download links for a BlitzReels clip batch.

toolsPreview.name: clips_manage
toolsPreview.description: List or inspect clips, regenerate an exact range or suggestion with layout and caption settings, repair visual QA, start export, inspect caption words, or apply a verified caption look.

toolsPreview.name: clip_batches_delete
toolsPreview.description: Preview or delete a terminal clip batch. Dry-run is the default; real deletion requires explicit confirmation, retention choice, workspace delete permission, and an idempotency key.

toolsPreview.name: timeline_edit_apply
toolsPreview.description: Trim or extend one timeline item. Split one timeline item at an exact sequence position.

toolsPreview.name: timeline_edit_preview
toolsPreview.description: Preview without mutation. Trim or extend one timeline item. Split one timeline item at an exact sequence position.

toolsPreview.name: update_timeline_clip
toolsPreview.description: Update one timeline item's start, duration, trim, layer, ignored state, or blurred background. Provide at least one field to update besides timelineItemId.

toolsPreview.name: batch_update_timeline_clips
toolsPreview.description: Update timing, trim, layer, or state for up to 100 timeline items in one sequence transaction.

toolsPreview.name: mute_clip_audio
toolsPreview.description: Set one timeline media item's volume to zero.

toolsPreview.name: delete_timeline_items
toolsPreview.description: Preview or delete up to 100 timeline items and optionally remove linked captions.

toolsPreview.name: add_text_overlay
toolsPreview.description: Add an editable text overlay to a project timeline at an exact time and layer.

toolsPreview.name: add_transition
toolsPreview.description: Add a timed transition effect, optionally attached to one timeline item and paired with sound.

toolsPreview.name: workflows_list
toolsPreview.description: List public BlitzReels workflows that can be imported into a workspace.

toolsPreview.name: workflows_import
toolsPreview.description: Import a public BlitzReels workflow into the user's workspace.

toolsPreview.name: workflows_get
toolsPreview.description: Get a workflow definition, input schema, defaults, and ordered steps.

toolsPreview.name: workflow_runs_create
toolsPreview.description: Create an interactive workflow run from a workflow and optional inputs.

toolsPreview.name: workflow_runs_get
toolsPreview.description: Get workflow run status, step statuses, outputs, warnings, and dashboard URL.

toolsPreview.name: workflow_runs_execute_step
toolsPreview.description: Execute one pending workflow run step and return updated run status.

toolsPreview.name: timeline_media_add
toolsPreview.description: Place an uploaded image or video asset onto the actual BlitzReels project timeline at a timestamp. Use after media_upload_file when the user asks to add B-roll, a static image, or visual media to the video.

toolsPreview.name: timeline_audio_add
toolsPreview.description: Place an uploaded audio asset onto the actual BlitzReels project timeline at a timestamp. Use after media_upload_file when the user asks to add voiceover, music, or audio to a video.

toolsPreview.name: exports_start
toolsPreview.description: Render/export a BlitzReels video project after timeline edits. Returns export and job IDs that can be polled with exports_list.

toolsPreview.name: generation_options_list
toolsPreview.description: List the models, defaults, limits, and credit costs available for one generation kind before queueing it.

toolsPreview.name: generation_image_create
toolsPreview.description: Queue an AI image generation into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_video_create
toolsPreview.description: Queue an AI video generation into the BlitzReels media library, from a prompt or from an existing image asset. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_voiceover_create
toolsPreview.description: Queue a text-to-speech voiceover into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_music_create
toolsPreview.description: Queue a background music track into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_sound_create
toolsPreview.description: Queue a sound effect into the BlitzReels media library. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_faceless_create
toolsPreview.description: Turn a script into a full faceless video project: scene plan, generated visuals, optional voiceover, captions, music, and sound. Spends AI credits and returns a job to poll with generation_jobs_get.

toolsPreview.name: generation_jobs_get
toolsPreview.description: Check a queued generation. Completed jobs carry the media asset ID and a download URL.

toolsPreview.name: generation_jobs_cancel
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a queued or running generation before it finishes spending credits.

toolsPreview.name: generation_plan_brief
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the authoring brief for an AI video generation plan: the target model's prompting grammar, capability constraints, locked style contract, and the plan JSON schema. Author the plan yourself from this brief, then check it with generation_plan_validate.

toolsPreview.name: generation_plan_validate
toolsPreview.description: Validate a self-authored generation plan against the schema and the target model's real capabilities before execution. Returns directive errors to fix and revalidate; only a valid plan is executable.
